itemList.description: Pumps:- Supply & delivery at site brand new Kriloskar/Flow more/M&P make approved by board horizontal split case centrifugal pump confirming to latest ISS 1520 & ISS5120 and of the following description duty condition (a) capacity of pump in LPS50.06/170 CUBIC mtr/hour (b) total dynamic head mtr 76 (c) RPM 1460 (d) shutoff Head min 110% & max 130% of specific head material of construction (1) casing cast Iron (2) impellor-Cf8M (3) shaft SS410 (4) casing wear ring CA6mm sleeves SS40.

Supplying of 55kw/75HP 4 pole brand new Kriloskar/ Marthon Make horizontal foot Mounted SPDP squirrel cage induction motor 1475 rpm 3 PH 415 volts 50Hz insulation F Class cushion 10% more than power required by the pump and capable of providing Rated out put upto +or- 10% voltage variation.
Supplying & fixing of MS flanges for suction and delivery manifold pipe including Welding and alignment.
Supplying & fixing of couplings heavy duty common ms base plate for pump & motor with suitable I section girder, channels, plates, bolts & nuts etc.
Supplying & Fixing of MS specials of suitable sizes and demission both section side and delivery side including all packing and fasteners and fabrication labour charges.
Supplying & fixing 250mm kirloskar/ ISI make heavy foot Valve.
Supplying of M.S pipe 8mm heavy duty  for Suction side .

Erection & Commissioning pump set-formation of suitable block machine foundation In CC1:2:4 separately for each pump set ( including stand pump sets) conforming to the Latest ISS 2974/using all the required materials such as cement sand, jelly etc. Complete including necessary earth work excavation refilling curing etc. complete erection of the pump set mounted on the common base plate on the above foundation Using the required materials such as foundation bolts, key locks, self inter locking bolts, washers etc, complete Leveling aligning of the pump sets on the foundation grounding and dynamic balancing of the pump set on the above foundation using all the required Materials including such as foundation bolts, key locks. Self inter locking bolts washers etc complete leveling alignment of pump set and giving satisfactory trail test.
Supplying At Site ATS or Suitable 75 Hp Starter Operating of 440 Volt, 50 HZ and up gradiation control panel at wambe colony  pump house
Fixing of starter making of new block foundation installation and commissioning Including making connections to control panel and motor termination by supplying of Lugs etc.
Supply & Fixing of 6 Inch dia Pressure Gauge meter ISI make along with pipe fittings complete .
Dismantling of old pump set Removing of old valves and MS pipe &Removing of Foundation by Breaker etc.
Transportation of all materials, machines etc from agency to site loading unloading etc complete
Lathing Work, Pipe welding Charges, Commissining work complete
